## About
After an accident, the last thing you need is a pile of unknowns. Can the car be fixed? How long will it take? Will insurance pay for it? We help answer those questions and keep you updated while we work, so you know what is going on at every step.
We are a family shop carrying on a tradition in auto body repair across generations. We are a member of the California Auto Body Association and independently operated. Our technicians are I-Car certified, and we keep investing in their training and in our painting and frame straightening equipment.
Gor, our manager, comes up by name in our reviews. We are rated 4.9 on Google from 41 reviews, and we would like to earn the next one from you.

## Services
- Dent repair: From a small dent to a car that is close to totaled, our technicians and equipment are set up to handle it.
- Painting and color matching: Expert painting with computerized color matching, plus detailing. Proper paint protects the metal underneath from rust.
- Body work: A dent on the door can hide a bigger problem, so we check the whole vehicle for chassis and structural issues.
- Vehicle evaluation: Every job starts with an evaluation. We photograph your car when it arrives and throughout the repair.
- Total loss vehicles: If your car may be totaled, we can evaluate and value it.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help me deal with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We help with communication between you and your insurance company, and we can help you arrange other transportation while your car is in the shop.

Q: How do you make sure my car is safe before I pick it up?
A: We run a 134 point check and test drive the vehicle before we hand it back.

Q: What kind of paint do you use?
A: We use water based paint and environmentally friendly recycling.

Q: How do I set up a repair?
A: Give us a call to schedule an appointment.
